item.title: Her Murder Conviction Was Overturned After Prosecutor Misconduct
item.description: Noura Jackson was convicted of killing her mother, Jennifer Jackson, in 2009, despite no forensic evidence linking her to the crime. Tennessee’s Supreme Court later overturned the conviction after finding constitutional violations by prosecutors. Jackson ultimately entered an Alford plea to voluntary manslaughter while maintaining her innocence.

item.title: DNA Finally Identified April Tinsley’s Killer 30 Years Later
item.description: Eight-year-old April Tinsley was killed in Indiana in 1988, and her killer later taunted investigators with threatening notes. Three decades later, genetic genealogy narrowed the search to John D. Miller, whose DNA matched evidence from the case. He confessed after his 2018 arrest.

item.title: The Death Police Said Was An Accident Still Raises Questions
item.description: Tamla Horsford died after falling from a balcony at a Georgia home in 2018 while attending an overnight gathering. Authorities ultimately ruled her death accidental, but her family and supporters have continued to question the investigation and the circumstances surrounding her death.

item.title: Baby Lisa Vanished From Her Crib And Was Never Found
item.description: Ten-month-old Lisa Irwin disappeared from her Kansas City home in October 2011. Her parents said she vanished from her crib overnight, triggering a massive search and years of scrutiny. No confirmed trace of Lisa has ever been found, and the case remains unsolved.

item.title: His 911 Call Captured The Moment He Was Killed
item.description: Former NBA player Lorenzen Wright vanished in Memphis in 2010, and his body was found days later. Investigators discovered that a 911 call from his phone had captured gunshots. His ex-wife later pleaded guilty to facilitating his murder, while Billy Ray Turner was convicted in the killing.

item.title: She Vanished During A 13 Minute Gap At Her Salon
item.description: Patrice Endres disappeared from her Georgia salon in 2004 during a narrow window between customer calls. Her remains were found behind a church the following year, but her wedding ring was missing. More than two decades later, no one has been charged and the case remains unsolved.

item.title: She Changed Her Story 10 Times After Steven Was Shot
item.description: Mary Katherine Higdon said the 2018 shooting of her boyfriend Steven Freeman was an accident, but prosecutors said she revised or added to her account 10 times. At trial, she argued self-defense and was ultimately found not guilty on all charges.

item.title: She Survived A Point Blank Ambush
item.description: Crime scene investigator Nicki Lenway was shot twice at point blank range outside a Minneapolis parenting center in 2022. She survived critical injuries, and investigators later uncovered a murder plot tied to a bitter custody dispute involving her son’s father.

item.title: She Vanished Minutes After Getting Off The School Bus
item.description: Sixteen-year-old Ali Lowitzer disappeared in Spring, Texas, on April 26, 2010, after getting off her school bus and planning to walk to her new job nearby. She never arrived, and despite years of searches and renewed age-progressed images, no confirmed trace of her has been found.
